description: Threads for His Final Target Book 1: Sloane's past, the contract, and the rooftop trap.

threads.name: The Blackridge Contract
threads.book1_resolution: Sloane uncovers the full truth: she staged Mara's death and erased her own memory to expose Rook's manipulation of her assassination network.
threads.book2_promise: The public revelation of the contract and ledger creates new enemies among the victims' families.
threads.book1_payoff: The central mystery is resolved in chapter 13 with a complete explanation assembled from physical evidence.
threads.note: Central mystery thread; canon reveal at ch13.

threads.name: Recover the Sealed Memories
threads.book1_resolution: Sloane retrieves all three recorded memories and remembers all seven names she ordered killed, fully reclaiming her past by chapter 14.
threads.book2_promise: Sloane must live with the full weight of her past actions and the person she used to be.
threads.book1_payoff: Each recovered memory restores a piece of the truth, building to complete recollection by chapter 14.
